hackathon_demo_flow: Enter the aspiration: I want to become an AI Engineer
innovation_statement: AspiraPath AI is a constraint-aware Generative AI career navigator that dynamically converts a student's aspirations and real-world limitations into personalized education, skill and career pathways.
pitch: Every student has a dream, but not every student knows the path to reach it. AspiraPath AI takes a student's aspiration, academic profile, skills, budget, time and location constraints and transforms them into a personalized career roadmap. It identifies skill gaps, recommends education pathways, projects and certification categories, creates a weekly action plan and provides an AI-based career-readiness indicator. Its key differentiator is the What-If Career Simulator, which dynamically creates a new pathway when a student changes a constraint. AspiraPath AI is an AI career navigator that answers: Given where I am today, my limitations and my aspirations, what can I realistically do next?
